title: Expenditure and Employment Data for the Criminal Justice System [United States]: CJEE Extracts File, 1989
description:
These criminal justice expenditure and employment (CJEE)
 data are taken from a special compilation of sources available from the
 Census Bureau's Annual Surveys of Governments, Finance Statistics and
 Employment Statistics. Levels of government covered are federal, state,
 county, municipal, and towns and townships. Information is included on
 total employment, total police protection, police protection with arrest
 powers, other police protection, judicial-legal employment, corrections
 employment, total expenditures, police protection expenditures,
 judicial-legal expenditures, and corrections expenditures. Types of
 expenditures include direct current, capital outlay, equipment, and
 intergovernmental. Types of employment include total, full-time,
part-time, and full-time equivalent.
